text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 7.8% overall, so I should keep risk appropriate for retirement and review whether my holdings are too concentrated.","Several sales came after steep losses; I should avoid letting recent declines alone trigger a sale and instead follow a deliberate plan for each holding.","Selling Stock C at a gain while selling other stocks at losses reminds me to judge each position by its prospects and role in my portfolio, not just its gain or loss versus cost."]}
